name: manual_7c1213
claim: Date certificate renewal reminders from the earliest expiry among every peer that must connect, not only the local host, and state each expiry in the reminder text.

decisions.notes: 2026-11-28: the Windows server certificate expires 2027-01-16, before the Mac one on 2027-01-21. Reminders moved to 2027-01-04 and 2027-01-11.

rationale: 2026-11-28: the Windows server certificate expires 2027-01-16, before the Mac one on 2027-01-21. Reminders moved to 2027-01-04 and 2027-01-11.
